Deviation: source archives are cached under the --cache directory (<cache>/source/<owner>__<repo>/<commit>.tar.gz, default the ignored docs/testing/repository-compatibility/.cache), not campaign/.cache/source; set --cache campaign/.cache to get the design path.
Deviation: tar runs with cwd = archive directory and a relative archive name, because Git-for-Windows GNU tar reads C: in -f as a remote host.
Deviation: the child environment allowlist also has HOME and USERPROFILE (Docker CLI config lookup), besides PATH, SYSTEMROOT and DOCKER_*.
Deviation: --local is also exclusive with --gate (the local mode runs the gate itself); design listed only --real-aws, --cleanup, --audit.
Addition: optional buildVariables list in the deploy-config repository entry (same shape as config); design says build args come from 'deploy-config build variables' but the schema had none.
Build with a Windows host: files extracted on Windows lose Unix mode bits; Docker Desktop sets 0755 on context files. Run-stage results for scripts that need exact modes may differ from CodeBuild.

A failed or interrupted source/build stage is only sticky for FAIL results; a thrown harness error leaves the stage IN_PROGRESS so --resume restarts it. Source fetch and tar errors are recorded as source FAIL.
